name: gofive-exams
description: Single-container host for the english-test and mbti assessment engines (path-routed: /english + /mbti).

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/english && npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../../mbti && npm install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/english run build -- --base=/english/ && npm --prefix apps/mbti run build -- --base=/mbti/
